$comment: ADR-340: tuning for ruin-home base behaviour (ai/planner.ts, ai/claim_build.ts). A bot that claimed + reclaimed an abandoned ruin never gets mem.base (ADR-337), so the planner's behaviour goals run against the adopted ruin home instead: furnishRadius = how far from the ruin centre a piece of the same key counts as 'already furnished'; upgradeRadius = how far from the ruin centre a tiered piece may stand and still be the upgrade target. Both radii are around the ruin CENTRE (the ruinBase anchor + 1). The `base` goal (BASE_SLOTS build) never runs for a ruin home — that is code, not a knob.
